title: 14mm Female to 18mm Male adapter
description:
Making things work with this glass adapter from Elev8 glass.
One end of the adapter has a 14mm female glass connection while the other end holds a 18mm male connection.
If you are unsure about compatibility please don’t hesitate to get in touch.
Included
1 x 14mm Female – 18mm Male Glass adapter
